title: Nick DiGiovanni's Brined & Herb-Butter-Basted Pan-Seared Chicken Breast
originalTitle: Nick DiGiovanni's Brined & Herb-Butter-Basted Pan-Seared Chicken Breast
ingredients: 2 bone-in or boneless skin-on chicken breasts
Quick Aromatic Brine: 2 cups warm water, 2 tbsp kosher salt, 1 tbsp sugar, 3 smashed garlic cloves, 1 bay leaf, 2 sprigs thyme, 1 sprig rosemary, 1 tsp peppercorns, plus 2 cups ice
1.5 tbsp high-smoke-point avocado or grapeseed oil
3 cloves garlic (crushed), 3 sprigs fresh thyme, 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Dissolve salt and sugar in warm water with garlic, bay leaf, thyme, rosemary, and peppercorns, then add ice to chill completely. Submerge chicken breasts in the cold brine for 45–60 minutes.
Remove chicken from the brine and pat bone-dry with paper towels (dry surface = golden glass-crispy skin).

Heat oil in a stainless steel or cast-iron skillet over high heat. Lay chicken skin-side down away from you, reduce heat to medium-high, and press with a chef's weight for even contact; sear 5–6 minutes until deep golden.

Flip the chicken, immediately add butter, crushed garlic, thyme, and rosemary, and continuously baste the chicken with foaming brown butter for 4–5 minutes until 160°F internal (carries over to 165°F while resting).
